summary: Fixed pyproject.toml (setuptools 66 syntax, Python >=3.11, dynamic version from _version.py, explicit namespace-safe packages, package data incl. templates/regions without drafts, renderers entry point group, console script to commands:main), MANIFEST.in (CSV no longer excluded, timings pruned), and orbis.postal.__version__ now imported from _version. Verified sdist, release/dev wheels and a fresh install. Note: packaging.md says group orbis.postal.renderer (singular) but the code and plugins.md read orbis.postal.renderers, so I used the plural.
